The '''Haserian sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> located along the [[Reena Trade Route]]. Two [[Star system/Legends|systems]]&mdash;[[Monastery system/Legends|Monastery]] and [[Haseria system/Legends|Haseria]] lay along the route. The territory was first explored between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], when the settlement of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] began and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] was expanded nearly to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="atlas" />

Along the Reena Trade Route, the average [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] population was 100 million to 500 million circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], while this number dropped to 10 million to 100 million in the other areas of the sector.<ref name="atlas" />
